speak.title: Role-play: a wallet at one in the morning
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You have found a wallet with cash and a student card. It is nearly midnight. You want to go and look for the owner tonight. Explain why it matters and ask your friend to come with you.

b.text: You are tired and want to go home. You think the wallet should go to the police in the morning. Give your reasons, ask questions, then agree on a plan.

phrases: I've just found a wallet on the pavement.
I can't leave it until tomorrow.
Wouldn't it be easier to take it to the police?
What if we try the hostels first?
I'm tired, but I'll come for one hour.
Let's do it, and we'll feel better afterwards.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: what did you decide to do, and was it the right choice?
